newsitem.title: USA: Telxon in cooperative deal with Pricer AB.
newsitem.headline: Telxon in cooperative deal with Pricer AB.

text.p: Telxon Corp said Thursday it has an agreement with Pricer AB to cooperate in developing and marketing technology in their common wireless communication and information transfer system businesses for the retail industry.
Telxon said it has agreed to invest $10 million, for a 10 percent share, in Pricer as part of their cooperative deal.
The part ownership is limited to the United States and Canada, Telxon said. Central and South America markets will remain wholly owned by Pricer.
Telxon supplies radio-based local area networks with portable hand-held computers for retail stores. Pricer is involved in infra-red based electronic shelf lables and communications systems.
The agreement between the two companies covers the creation of a combination local area network for wireless communication using both Telxon's radio technology and Pricer's infra-red technology.
The first joint product is to be introduced in early February.

Telxon said the $10 million investment will be made in three installments from January 1997 through 1998. The final two payments are conditioned on the requirement that production costs are not exceeded and that Pricer's new electronic shelf labels system, known as R2, is introduced as planned.
